evidenceBoundary: Static inspection and deterministic scripted-provider tests only. No live cloud inference was invoked.
problemRecovered: AgentRuntime assembled repository context once at run start and retained its original excerpts after a successful workspace mutation. A later model turn could therefore receive stale file content.

afterSuccessfulWorkspaceMutation: Refresh RepositoryIntelligence for the changed path, or conservatively for the workspace when a potentially mutating command has no path.
Remove the bootstrap repository excerpts and their exported evidence references.
Replace prior read_file observations for changed files with an explicit invalidation marker.
Require a fresh read before the next model turn may rely on file content.
change.failureMode: If refresh cannot build a fresh index, stale excerpts and read observations still remain removed; the next turn receives a runtime invalidation notice rather than stale content.
change.efficiency: The runtime does not rebuild and retransmit a full context pack after every edit. It refreshes the index and uses incremental re-read, avoiding coordination latency and repeated context bytes.

proven: A post-read edit removes the original bootstrap excerpt and invalidates the previous read observation before the next model request.
Repository generation is refreshed and the run records context refresh/invalidation metrics.
An unavailable refresh fails closed with stale context removed.
The fixed behavior preserves the existing context and parallel-worktree regressions without increasing their configured timeout.
notProven: Live-model correctness or token savings from incremental re-read.
The optimal context refresh policy for every repository size or command class.
Browser-research, generated-artifact, and external-tool freshness beyond the governed workspace mutation surface.
requiredNextEvidence: Paired live free-route engineering runs that record context refreshes, fresh reads, provider token receipts, verification outcomes, and any route/quota blockers under the same repository state and completion criteria.
